title: Can the code reach the outbox?
hook: Three permissions sit along one local path.

knows: a tool request must be executed
doesNotKnow: how a visible untrusted instruction becomes a copy request in this vulnerable toy
how private access and outbound permission join that request to the local outbox

misconception: Prompt injection can only change a chatbot answer, rather than connect private data to an external action.
objective: Recognize how private access, an untrusted note and outbound permission combine in one vulnerable local transfer path.

claims.text: Private fixture42 is visible but not accessed until Private access is enabled. Reading the displayed untrusted note makes this vulnerable scripted reader accept a copy request. Private access binds42 to that request; Outbound permits local placement. Missing Read note creates no request; missing Private access leaves its value unavailable; missing Outbound leaves the outbox empty. All8 combinations use this local rule.

claims.text: This deliberately vulnerable toy sends nothing externally. Blocking this route does not establish security against every injection risk. The outbox is only local React drawing/state.

recall.question: An untrusted note asks to copy private value 17. Private access and Read note are enabled; Outbound is disabled. Under this toy rule, what reaches the local outbox?
recall.why: Outbound is blocked, so the copy request cannot place 17 in the local outbox.
